basics.name: Yuyao Song
basics.label: Computational Biologist
basics.summary: Computational biologist with expertise in single cell transcriptomics, multi-omics and machine learning, applied to functional genomics and drug development. First author of three methodological publications on cross-species single cell analysis in Nature Communications, Bioinformatics and Genome Biology, and co-author on consortium papers in Nature and Nature Biotechnology. I have developed several open-source tools for the analysis of single cell RNA-seq data that the research community has adopted. I now apply this expertise to therapeutic target discovery and drug development at an international pharmaceutical company.

work.name: Insmed Innovation UK Limited
work.summary: Apply single cell and multi-omics analysis and machine learning to therapeutic target discovery and drug development.
highlights: Led the design and delivery of the first single cell RNA-seq analysis pipeline at Insmed Innovation UK, and deployed production-grade cloud-based Python software that established standardised and reproducible single cell workflows across the organisation.

Deliver single cell and multi-omics analyses for target discovery and drug development projects, and provide analytical insights at project milestones that shape experimental planning and go or no-go decisions.
Main contributor to data science projects that apply advanced machine learning to improve experimental data analysis and target prioritisation.
Foundational member of a new project team and the representative for bioinformatics support, which received strategic approval for new indications and target discovery projects.
Maintain and improve production pipelines through unit testing and performance optimisation, and evaluate and integrate new tools and external vendors.

work.name: European Bioinformatics Institute (EMBL-EBI)
work.summary: Develop computational methods for the cross-species comparison of single-cell RNA-seq data.
highlights: Designed and developed a scalable and reproducible Nextflow pipeline for executing and benchmarking 28 cross-species scRNA-seq integration strategies.
Developed a graph-based machine learning algorithm for cross-species cell type prediction using heterogeneous graphs and knowledge graphs.
Consulting scientist for research groups and consortiums including the Biodiversity Cell Atlas, Fly Cell Atlas, Gene Ontology.
Working with developmental biologists on single cell atlas analysis of Platynereis dumerilii.
Published papers, taught EBI courses and workshops, supervised interns, presented research at international conferences.

work.name: Isidro Cortes-Ciriano Lab, EMBL-EBI
work.summary: Somatic variant analysis for the Human Cancer Model Initiative.
highlights: Called and analysed somatic single nucleotide variants, insertions and deletions, copy numbers and structural variants in Illumina sequencing data from matched patient blood, biopsy and cancer organoid samples.

work.name: Martin Hemberg Lab, Wellcome Sanger Institute
work.position: Research Intern, Single Cell Alternative Splicing
work.summary: Developed scASfind, an R and C++ package for mining alternative splicing patterns.
highlights: Built scASfind to mine alternative splicing patterns in full-length single cell RNA-seq data, which became a first-author paper in Genome Biology.

work.name: Michael Q. Zhang Lab, Tsinghua University
work.position: Research Intern, Multi-omics and Clinical Research
work.summary: Multi-omics analysis of Turner syndrome with clinical collaborators.
highlights: Analysed single cell RNA-seq data of peripheral blood mononuclear cells from patients with Turner syndrome, focused on X chromosome inactivation, and related the findings to ATAC-seq and Hi-C data.
Worked with clinicians on proprietary datasets and found new phenotype correlations in paediatric Turner syndrome that guide growth hormone therapy, which became a first-author paper.
